about.text:
NetSim Web – browser-based network simulator (Phase 1: foundation + layer 2).
No real IOS, no real network access.
hint.placing: Click the workspace to place the device (Esc = cancel).
hint.cableA: Cable: click the first device and choose a port.
hint.cableB: Cable: click the second device and choose a port.
hint.pduB: PDU: click the destination device (ICMP echo).
hint.delete: Click a device or cable to delete it.

palette.placeHint: Click, then click the workspace – or drag and drop

panel.title: Device

port.name: Port
ip.notAHost: This device has no host stack.
ip.gatewayOffSubnet: The gateway is not in the host's subnet.
toast.noTargetIp: The destination device has no IP address.
ping.noIp: This device has no IP configuration yet.
ping.reply: Reply from {{ip}}: bytes={{bytes}} time={{time}} ms TTL={{ttl}}
ping.noRoute: Destination network unreachable: no route/gateway for {{ip}}.
ping.hostUnreachable: Destination host unreachable ({{ip}}): ARP got no answer.

sim.title: Simulation
cable.problem.rollover: rollover cable only works on console ports
cable.problem.console: console port needs a rollover cable
cable.reject.sameDevice: A cable cannot have both ends on the same device.
cable.reject.plug: The connector does not fit this port.
cable.reject.fiber: Fibre only works between SFP/fibre ports.
cable.reject.unsupported: This cable type is not supported yet.
tx.linkDown: Cannot send on {{port}}: link is down → frame dropped.
rx.collisionRunt: Frame damaged by a collision (runt) → dropped.
csma.backoff: Collision detected (attempt {{attempt}}) → backing off {{slots}} slot times on {{port}}.
hub.collision: Layer 1: Collision! {{count}} transmissions overlap → jam signal on all ports.
hub.repeat: Layer 1: hub repeats the signal from {{port}} to {{count}} other ports.
host.l2.notForMe: Layer 2: destination MAC {{dst}} ≠ own MAC {{mac}} → frame dropped.
host.noIp: Host has no IP configuration → packet dropped.
host.arp.gratuitous: Layer 2: gratuitous ARP ({{ip}} is at {{mac}}) → existing cache entry updated.
host.arp.notMine: Layer 2/3: ARP request for {{ip}} – not my address → dropped.
host.arp.conflict: Duplicate IP address! {{ip}} is also used by {{mac}}.
host.arp.request: Layer 2/3: ARP request for my address {{ip}} from {{sender}} → sending ARP reply (unicast).
host.arp.reply: Layer 2/3: ARP reply: {{ip}} has MAC {{mac}} → added to ARP cache, queued packets are sent.
host.arp.failed: ARP for {{ip}} got no answer after 3 attempts.
host.ip.notMine: Layer 3: destination IP {{dst}} is not my address → dropped.
host.icmp.broadcastIgnored: Layer 3: broadcast echo request is not answered.
host.icmp.echoRequest: Layer 3: ICMP echo request from {{src}} accepted → sending echo reply.
host.icmp.echoReply: Layer 3: ICMP echo reply from {{src}} accepted.
switch.filter: Layer 2: destination is on the ingress port {{port}} → frame filtered (not forwarded).
switch.filter.learned: Learned MAC {{src}} on {{port}}. Destination is on the ingress port → frame filtered.
switch.outDown: Layer 2: egress port is down → frame dropped.
switch.unicast: Layer 2: destination MAC {{dst}} known → unicast forwarding on {{out}}.
switch.unicast.learned: Learned MAC {{src}} on {{port}}. Destination MAC {{dst}} known → unicast on {{out}}.
switch.flood: Layer 2: destination unknown/broadcast → flooding to {{count}} ports.
switch.flood.learned: Learned MAC {{src}} on {{port}}. Destination unknown/broadcast → flooding to {{count}} ports.
sys.deviceCrashed: Device crashed: {{message}}. The rest of the simulation keeps running.
ping.ttlExpired: TTL expired in transit: time exceeded from {{ip}}.
ping.fragNeeded: Packet needs to be fragmented but DF is set ({{ip}}).
ip.notARouter: This device is not a router.
ip.networkAddress: This is the subnet's network address – invalid as a host address.
ip.fragment: Layer 3: packet ({{size}} bytes) exceeds MTU {{mtu}} → split into {{count}} fragments (destination {{dst}}).
ip.fragmentHeld: Layer 3: fragment (offset {{offset}}) from {{src}} buffered – waiting for more fragments.
ip.reassembled: Layer 3: all fragments from {{src}} arrived → packet ({{size}} bytes) reassembled and accepted.
router.ttlExpired: Layer 3: TTL expired (packet {{src}} → {{dst}}) → dropped, ICMP time exceeded sent to the source.
router.noRoute: Layer 3: no route to {{dst}} → dropped, ICMP destination net unreachable sent to the source.
router.needFrag: Layer 3: packet ({{size}} bytes) exceeds MTU {{mtu}} of {{port}} with DF set → dropped, ICMP fragmentation needed.
router.forward: Layer 3: routing decision: {{dst}} via {{via}} out {{port}} (TTL now {{ttl}}).
host.icmp.error: Layer 3: ICMP error message from {{src}} received ({{type}}, code {{code}}).
nat.exhausted: NAT: address pool exhausted – packet from {{src}} dropped.
ip.noService: No service on port {{port}} – packet dropped.
dhcp.expired: DHCP client: lease expired – requesting again.
dhcp.clientConflict: DHCP client: address {{ip}} already in use (ARP) – DECLINE.
dhcp.noPool: DHCP server: no matching pool for {{mac}}.
dhcp.conflict: DHCP server: address {{ip}} marked as conflict.
dhcp.relayDown: DHCP relay: {{op}} for {{mac}} forwarded to client.
tcp.syn: TCP: connection request from {{peer}} to port {{port}}.
tcp.refused: TCP: port {{port}} answered with RST – connection refused.
tcp.rst: TCP: no listener on port {{port}} – RST sent.
tcp.unknown: TCP: segment from {{peer}} without connection dropped.
stp.bpduGuard: BPDU guard: BPDU received on {{port}} – port err-disabled.
stp.rootSelf: STP VLAN {{vlan}}: this switch is the root bridge ({{root}}).
switch.vlanNotAllowed: VLAN {{vlan}} is not allowed on {{port}} – frame dropped.
switch.taggedOnAccess: Tagged frame on access port {{port}} dropped.
switch.noVlan: VLAN {{vlan}} does not exist – frame dropped.
switch.stpBlocked: Port {{port}} is blocking (STP, VLAN {{vlan}}) – frame dropped.
switch.psec.restrict: Port security {{port}}: violation by {{mac}} – frame dropped, counter increased (restrict).
switch.psec.shutdown: Port security {{port}}: violation by {{mac}} – port err-disabled (shutdown).
sw.notASwitch: This device is not a switch.
sw.vtpClient: VLANs cannot be changed in VTP client mode.
sw.defaultVlan: This default VLAN cannot be deleted.
sw.invalidPriority: Priority must be a multiple of 4096 (0–61440).
svc.title: Services
ip6.linkLocalNeedsIface: An interface is required for a link-local next hop.
ip.routeNeedsTarget: The route needs a next hop or an exit interface.
ip6.notMine: IPv6 packet for {{dst}} dropped (not for this device, routing disabled).
ip6.echoRequest: ICMPv6 echo request from {{src}} ({{size}} bytes) → replying.
nd.dad.ok: DAD succeeded: address {{addr}} on {{iface}} is now usable.
nd.dad.dup: DAD: address {{addr}} on {{iface}} is already in use on the link (duplicate) and will not be used.
nd.failed: Neighbor discovery for {{ip}} got no answer.
eigrp.active: EIGRP DUAL: {{prefix}} goes active (no feasible successor) – query sent.
eigrp.sia: EIGRP DUAL: {{prefix}} stuck in active for 3 minutes – resetting neighbors {{nbrs}}.
gre.noRoute: GRE: no route to tunnel destination {{dst}}.
gre.noTunnel: GRE packet from {{src}} dropped (no matching tunnel interface).
hsrp.authFail: HSRP hello from {{src}} (group {{group}}, {{iface}}) dropped: authentication failed.
ospf.if.up: OSPF: interface {{iface}} up in area {{area}} (router ID {{rid}}).
ospf.authFail: OSPF packet from {{src}} (router ID {{rid}}) on {{iface}} dropped: authentication failed.
routing.none: No dynamic routing configured (CLI: router ospf/rip/eigrp/bgp).
tool.debugHint: Debug output appears in the CLI terminal (debug ip ospf adj …).
